head: Lullwind lullaby app for iPhone: a wind-up music box for babies
dek: Lullwind is a new iPhone and iPad app that plays lullabies on a wind-up timer, so the music slows down and fades out by itself. Parents can add rain or white noise and record a lullaby in their own voice.
details: The free version has 8 sounds, a 30-minute wind-up, one saved mix and one voice recording. The full version costs $9.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial, or $24.99 once. A night lamp mode dims the screen, and swipes and double-taps control it in the dark. The listing says it has no account, no ads and collects no data; it's made by Recep Gur.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later), out since 6 November
means: If bedtime sounds stop with a click and wake your baby, this one fades out slowly.
todo: Try the free version first; the yearly plan renews unless you cancel it.
